test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

Q _ L _ P Q P _ B P Q _ L B _ Q _ L _ P

options.text: P, B, L, P, P, P, B
P, P, P, B, B, L, Q
P, Q, P, L, P, B, P
P, Q, L, P, B, P, B

solution:
Given sequence: Q _ L _ P Q P _ B P Q _ L B _ Q _ L _ P

 
• P, B, L, P, P, P, B → Q **P** L **B** P - Q P **L** B P - Q **P** L B **P -** Q **P** L **B** P
 
• P, P, P, B, B, L, Q → Q **P** L **P** P - Q P **P** B P - Q **B** L B **B** - Q **L** L **Q** P
 
• P, Q, P, L, P, B, P → Q **P** L **Q** P - Q P **P** B P - Q **L** L B **P -** Q **B** L **P** P
 
• P, Q, L, P, B, P, B → Q **P** L **Q** P - Q P **L** B P - Q **P** L B **B** - Q **P** L **B** P

 
• In option 1, QPLBP is repeated.

Hence, '**P, B, L, P, P, P, B**' is the correct answer.
